questions.question: In the opening flashback, whom does Sméagol kill to take the Ring?
questions.note: His friend finds it while fishing. Sméagol strangles him for it.

questions.question: What seeing-stone does Pippin look into?
questions.note: Saruman's stone. Pippin sees Sauron, and Sauron sees him.

questions.question: To which city does Gandalf take Pippin on Shadowfax?
questions.note: The White City, capital of Gondor.

questions.question: Who rules Gondor as Steward?
questions.note: He grieves Boromir and has no wish for a king to return.

questions.question: How does Gondor call Rohan for help?
choices: By blowing the Horn of Gondor
questions.note: Pippin lights the first one himself. Théoden answers: 'And Rohan will answer.'

questions.question: What does Pippin pledge to Denethor?
questions.note: He owes Boromir a debt. He becomes a Guard of the Citadel.

questions.question: What city does Faramir ride out on a hopeless charge to retake?
questions.note: His father sends him. He comes back nearly dead.

questions.question: What does Pippin sing as Faramir rides out?
questions.answer: A sad Shire song, 'Edge of Night'
choices: A sad Shire song, 'Edge of Night'
questions.note: 'Home is behind, the world ahead.' Denethor eats while Pippin sings.

questions.question: What does Denethor try to do to the wounded Faramir?
questions.note: Pippin runs for Gandalf to stop it.

questions.question: How does Denethor die?
questions.answer: He leaps from the city, burning
choices: He leaps from the city, burning
He is killed by an Orc
questions.note: He sets himself alight on the pyre and runs off the top of the citadel.
